69M, OBSERVATION ADMIT admission from WALK-IN/SELF REFERRAL.
OUTCOME: discharged alive to SKILLED NURSING FACILITY
PRESENTING SYMPTOMS: Adult failure to thrive; Full incontinence of feces
PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS: Acute posthemorrhagic anemia
ACTIVE DIAGNOSES: Acute posthemorrhagic anemia; End stage renal disease; Encephalopathy, unspecified; Melena; Hypertensive chronic kidney disease with stage 5 chronic kidney disease or end stage renal disease; Fistula of intestine; Secondary malignant neoplasm of other specified sites; Secondary malignant neoplasm of small intestine; Secondary malignant neoplasm of retroperitoneum and peritoneum; Secondary malignant neoplasm of bladder; Anemia in chronic kidney disease; Malignant neoplasm of prostate; Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation; Hypotension, unspecified; Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chronic kidney disease; Obesity, unspecified; Vascular dementia, unspecified severity, without behavioral disturbance, psychotic disturbance, mood disturbance, and anxiety
PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: Encounter for palliative care; Do not resuscitate; Long term (current) use of insulin; Personal history of other malignant neoplasm of large intestine; Dependence on renal dialysis; Personal history of nicotine dependence; Body mass index [BMI] 30.0-30.9, adult; Personal history of transient ischemic attack (TIA), and cerebral infarction without residual deficits
PROCEDURES: Performance of Urinary Filtration, Intermittent, Less than 6 Hours Per Day; Insertion of Infusion Device into Superior Vena Cava, Percutaneous Approach
MEDICATIONS: Pantoprazole 40mg PO; Donepezil 5mg PO/NG; Sodium Chloride 0.9%  Flush 10-20mL IV; Lidocaine 1% 1mL ID; Sodium Chloride 0.9% 1000mL IV; Metoprolol Tartrate 25mg PO/NG; Morphine Sulfate (Oral Solution) 2 mg/mL 5-10mg PO/NG; Ondansetron 4mg IV; Bisacodyl 10mg PR; Metoprolol Succinate XL 50mg PO; Heparin 5000UNIT SC; Glucagon 1mg IM; QUEtiapine Fumarate 12.5mg PO/NG; amLODIPine 10mg PO/NG; Polyethylene Glycol 17g PO/NG; Calcitriol 1mcg PO; LORazepam Oral Solution 0.5mg PO/NG; D5 1/2NS 1000mL IV; Ketorolac 30mg IV; Lidocaine 1% (For PICC/Midline Insertions) 5mL SC; Glucose Gel 15g PO; Acetaminophen 500-1000mg PO/NG; Lactated Ringers 1000mL IV; Nephrocaps 1CAP PO/NG; Isosorbide Mononitrate (Extended Release) 30mg PO; Atorvastatin 20mg PO/NG; Dextrose 50% 12.5gm IV; Readi-Cat 2 (Barium Sulfate 2% Suspension) 900mL PO/NG; Heparin Flush (10 units/ml) 2mL IV; Insulin 0UNIT SC
MICROBIOLOGY: none
SERVICES: OMED
WARDS: Hematology/Oncology Intermediate; Emergency Department
